import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive analysis
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Define a color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", n_colors=len(df['brand'].unique()))

# 1. Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type (main plot)
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
sensor_types = df['sensor_type'].unique()
for sensor in sensor_types:
    subset = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax1.scatter(subset['megapixels'], subset['price_usd'], 
                alpha=0.6, s=50, label=sensor, edgecolors='w', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Average Price by Brand (top brands)
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
brand_price = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False).head(8)
bars = ax2.barh(brand_price.index, brand_price.values, color=sns.color_palette("viridis", n_colors=8))
ax2.set_xlabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Top 8 Brands by Average Price', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. 4K Video Capability Distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
video_4k_counts = df['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
labels = ['No 4K', '4K Capable']
colors_pie = ['#ff9999', '#66b3ff']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(video_4k_counts.values, labels=labels, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                     colors=colors_pie, startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 10})
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax3.set_title('4K Video Capability Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Weight vs Price colored by Body Type
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
body_types = df['body_type'].unique()
for body in body_types:
    subset = df[df['body_type'] == body]
    ax4.scatter(subset['weight_grams'], subset['price_usd'], 
                alpha=0.6, s=50, label=body, edgecolors='w', linewidth=0.5)
ax4.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Price vs Weight by Body Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9)
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 5. Camera Release Trend Over Years
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
year_counts = df['model_year'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax5.plot(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=6, color='#2ecc71', markerfacecolor='#27ae60', markeredgecolor='white')
ax5.fill_between(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, alpha=0.3, color='#2ecc71')
ax5.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Cameras', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Camera Releases by Year', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 6. ISO Performance Distribution by Sensor Type
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
sensor_order = df.groupby('sensor_type')['max_iso'].median().sort_values(ascending=False).index
sns.boxplot(data=df, y='sensor_type', x='max_iso', ax=ax6, 
            order=sensor_order, palette='Set2')
ax6.set_xlabel('Maximum ISO', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('ISO Performance by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis - Comprehensive Overview', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.99])
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
